I will do this plot mostly the way I know works here when the rains come. I own this land, so I will put some manure where I can, but cash is never enough to buy many inputs for nearly two hectares, so I will not buy chemical fertilizer this season. I will plant my usual local maize seed, I will use family hands for most work, and I will hire a few people only when we are late with weeding.
